floral.name: Rose
floral.basics: Roses are perennial flowering plants known for their beautiful blooms and fragrance.
floral.growing: Plant in well-drained soil with 6-8 hours of sunlight daily. Water deeply but infrequently.
floral.germinationSigns: First true leaves appear, stem strengthens
floral.precautions: Prune regularly, watch for aphids, provide good air circulation

problems.solution: Check watering schedule, may need fertilizer
Ensure adequate sunlight and proper pruning

floral.name: Hibiscus
floral.basics: Tropical flowering plant with large, colorful blooms.
floral.growing: Prefers warm climates, well-drained acidic soil.
floral.precautions: Protect from frost, regular feeding during growing season

problems.solution: Check for pests, ensure proper humidity

floral.name: Sunflower
floral.basics: Tall annual plants known for their large yellow blooms that follow the sun.
floral.growing: Requires full sun, well-drained soil, and regular watering.
floral.germinationSigns: Seedling emerges with sturdy stem and broad leaves
floral.precautions: Protect from strong winds, provide spacing for roots

problems.solution: May need staking or additional water
Ensure air circulation, apply fungicide if needed

floral.name: Lotus
floral.basics: Aquatic plant with symbolic significance in many cultures.
floral.growing: Requires still water and full sunlight.
floral.precautions: Keep water clean, protect from strong currents

problems.solution: Check water quality, may need nutrients

floral.name: Marigold
floral.basics: Hardy flowering plant popular for its bright orange and yellow blossoms.
floral.growing: Thrives in sunny locations with well-drained soil.
floral.germinationSigns: Seedlings with slender stems and small leaves
floral.precautions: Avoid overwatering, remove dead flowers to encourage blooms

problems.solution: Use insecticidal soap or neem oil

edible.name: Tomato
edible.basics: Popular fruit vegetable easy to grow in home gardens.
edible.growing: Full sun, well-drained soil, support for vines.

edible.name: Capsicum
edible.basics: Bell peppers, a type of capsicum, are available in various colors and heat levels.
edible.growing: Warm weather plant, needs consistent moisture.

edible.name: Lemon
edible.basics: Citrus fruit tree valued for its sour, vitamin C-rich fruits.
edible.growing: Requires full sunlight, well-drained slightly acidic soil.
edible.precautions: Protect from frost, water deeply but not frequently

problems.solution: Maintain consistent watering and avoid stress

edible.name: Chilli
edible.basics: Spicy fruiting plant used in cuisines worldwide.
edible.growing: Needs warm climate, full sunlight, and loamy soil.
edible.germinationSigns: Seedlings with slender stems and pointed leaves
edible.precautions: Avoid overwatering, support plants with stakes if heavy with fruit

problems.solution: Check for aphids and treat with neem oil
Ensure enough sunlight and phosphorus-rich fertilizer
